_comment: Config for eval/generate_eval.py. Targets sum to >=250 (six types). Gold sections are fixed by construction (the section is given to the drafter; it never chooses the number).
_drafter_note: provider=deepinfra uses DEEPINFRA_DRAFT_MODEL (default deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro, != Qwen generator). Set provider=anthropic to use drafter_model (Claude) instead.
